_comment: Fixture lock for scripts/test-description-budget.mjs. Same shape as the repo-root skills-lock.json. The key is a DISPLAY name, so it does not match the on-disk fixture directory verbatim — only the slugified key (vendored-over-budget) resolves it, which is the harder of the two resolution paths. skillPath is upstream's own folder and is deliberately unrelated to the local directory: the resolver must NOT use it. Not a real lock; nothing installs from it.
